scope: macOS arm64 DMG releases of the core and connected profiles with a standalone (non-framework) Python, ad-hoc signed; descendant cleanup with live child processes. Not Developer ID signed or notarized; not Linux/Windows; full profile not built.
implemented: Builder refuses bundles with directory symlinks (macOS framework Python), naming them; file symlinks install as content and are accepted. Build instructions use uv venv --managed-python.

Generated Tauri release config requests an ad-hoc macOS signature (signingIdentity '-') so the app passes strict verification and a quarantined copy can be allowed in Settings instead of reported damaged.
DMG built with CI=true to skip Finder AppleScript styling.

builds.interpreter: uv-managed CPython 3.13.16 (python-build-standalone, no framework), installed in ~/.local/share/uv/python
builds.inputs: Snapshot of nexus/, pyproject.toml, README.md and build_desktop.py in the scratchpad, because the other agent was editing sources and the builder correctly rejected changing inputs.
builds.framework_python_rejected: Directory symlinks _internal/Python.framework/Resources and Versions/Current named; nothing staged.

validation.dmg: hdiutil verify VALID for both; mounted read-only; app copied out like a user install; installed sidecar tree_sha256 equals manifest for both.
validation.signature: codesign --verify --deep --strict passes on DMG-installed apps (ad-hoc, hardened runtime on the shell, identifier com.nexusarc.studio).
